items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And he had a clarinet player named Frank Lewis... One night, I see him come over, Frank Lewis. He was sick.

ctx.x: So how does Bolton fit into this?

Now, let me show you. Well, Frank Deucin. I was a kid, right to separation from the hall to my house, in a big picket fence. So I and a bunch of boys hanging around the corner. How old were you? Huh? Oh, around about 12. So, me living next to the hall. The fellow used to run it. Called him, uh, John Shailis. He was a manager. So I'd ask him. I said, John said, let me sweep up the hall.
